tagline: Governed Discovery → Delivery with an autonomous daemon.
keyFeatures: Conversational Discovery phase produces an Epics/Stories backlog as a git-tracked contract
Autonomous Delivery daemon runs each Story in an isolated Claude Code tmux session (3 slots by default)
QA gates per Story plus persistent cross-session memory
Live tmux monitoring dashboard for concurrent Story deliveries
Plain Markdown + YAML + bash — no SDK dependency; successor to AI-Governor-Framework
limitations: Elastic License 2.0 — source-available, not OSI open source
No GitHub Releases — versions exist as git tags only
Isolation is per tmux session, not per git worktree
